(A) 9am to 11am
(B) 4pm to 8pm
(C) 7am to 9am
(D) 11am to 4pm

Thus, Leslie could have left the tennis court between 4pm and 8pm. This time period is not explicitly listed in the options, but it is the only time period that satisfies all the conditions.
